intent: The G29 shifter fix stops failing silently when the wheel is powered on with its selector in the PS4 position: the ensure unit names the mode, sends a critical desktop notification, and retries every 5 minutes until the selector is flipped; a wheel that is merely absent no longer fails the unit.
scope: linux_configuration/fixes/g29_wheel_mode.sh (new, sourced): mode detection native/ps4/compat/absent, explanation strings, root-safe desktop notification
linux_configuration/fixes/fix_g29_shifter.sh: find_device/--ensure/--status use the helper; udev reload moved after the ensure rule is installed
non-goal: supporting PS4 mode itself (C260 has a different report layout and no kernel driver; only the physical selector leaves it)
changes: Root cause from the journal: boots on 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-17 enumerated the wheel as 046D:C260 (PS4 mode, hid-generic). Every layer keyed on C24F, so the unit exited 1 with 'no G29 found' once at boot and nothing was said; 1st/3rd stayed on the firmware decode until the selector was flipped a day later (C260 -> disconnect -> C294 -> C24F).
g29_wheel_mode() classifies the HID bus; --ensure exits 0 when absent, exits 1 + notify-send -u critical (fixed id, replaces) when ps4/compat, attaches when native.

Unit retries on failure every 5 min so a notification lost before the session bus exists at boot is re-sent; ensure udev rule matches C260 so a wheel powered on in PS4 mode is reported at hotplug too.

verification.evidence: 1..13, all ok (mode classification, notify via sudo -u, --ensure exit codes 0/1 with fake sysfs, --status mode line)

rebuilt + installed; systemctl cat shows Restart=on-failure/RestartSec=5min; rule contains C260; udevadm trigger re-ran the unit: 'already attached; nothing to do'; --status: wheel mode: native, attached now: yes

verification.command: sudo bash -c 'source g29_wheel_mode.sh; g29_notify_desktop ...' (root context, real /run/user/1000/bus)
verification.evidence: sent as uid 0 via sudo -u kuhy; on-screen appearance is user-confirmed
shellcheck clean after replacing printf-stub with quoted heredoc and '! grep' with 'run ! grep'; 250-line cap, shell-library-has-tests, codespell all pass

risks: PS4-mode notification repeats every 5 minutes until the selector is flipped (same notification id, so it replaces rather than stacks) - intended, but noisy if PS4 mode is ever wanted on purpose
vmbox deliberately skipped: the guest has no G29, so a sandbox pass proves nothing for a physical-input fix
rollback: git revert the commit, then re-run linux_configuration/fixes/fix_g29_shifter.sh to reinstall the previous unit + rule
validate with fix_g29_shifter.sh --status and systemctl cat g29-shifter-bpf.service
